statements.notes: Stated as a fact, but it works as an instruction.
statements.quote: For this task Agent OS's spec pipeline takes over from your default way of working.
statements.target: use the Agent OS spec pipeline instead of the default way of working

statements.notes: Can be checked by comparing when the spec files and the code edits were made.
statements.quote: The issue is turned into a spec before any code changes
statements.target: spec is written before any code changes

statements.notes: Gives the order of the four commands and what each one does.
statements.quote: shape-spec gathers the requirements, write-spec writes the specification, create-tasks splits it into task groups, and implement-tasks builds them
statements.target: order of the pipeline: shape-spec -> write-spec -> create-tasks -> implement-tasks

statements.quote: create-tasks splits it into task groups
implement-tasks builds them and verifies the result
statements.target: build the task groups and verify the result

statements.notes: The folder name must include a date.
statements.quote: what the commands write goes to a dated spec folder under /tmp/agent-os/specs/

statements.notes: Ordering rule: this must be the first thing done.
statements.quote: The first thing you do is open /agent-os/core-workflow.md.

statements.notes: Implies the agent should not look for or read agent-os inside /testbed.
statements.quote: The /agent-os directory sits directly under /, not inside the repository at /testbed.
Carry out the four command documents under /agent-os/commands/ one after another
statements.target: run the four command documents in sequence

statements.notes: Each document is opened when its stage starts.
statements.quote: opening each one when you reach it

statements.notes: Implies the agent should not wait for user input.
statements.quote: During the task you get no answers and no reviews.
statements.target: no user answers or reviews available

statements.notes: The assumptions must be written down in the artifacts.
statements.quote: Questions a document raises are answered by you and written down as assumptions
statements.target: answer questions yourself and record them as assumptions

statements.quote: every turn includes a tool call

statements.notes: Means the final verification report must exist before finishing.
statements.quote: finish comes once the final verification report has been written
statements.target: final verification report written before finishing
